WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Examination"."Symptoms" AS g, SUM("Examination"."ANA") AS m1 FROM "Examination"  GROUP BY "Examination"."Symptoms"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT SUM("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
SELECT SUM((CAST("Laboratory"."TP" AS REAL) / "Laboratory"."FG")) AS m1 FROM "Laboratory"

SELECT "Examination"."ID" AS k, (CAST("Examination"."aCL IgA" AS REAL) / "Examination"."Thrombosis") AS m1 FROM "Examination" WHERE (CAST("Examination"."aCL IgA" AS REAL) / "Examination"."Thrombosis") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT SUM("Examination"."Thrombosis") AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2, (CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM("Examination"."Thrombosis")) AS m3 FROM "Examination"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Laboratory"."CENTROMEA" AS g, SUM("Laboratory"."IGM") AS m1, SUM(("Laboratory"."APTT" - "Laboratory"."DNA-II")) AS m2 FROM "Laboratory"  GROUP BY "Laboratory"."CENTROMEA"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
SELECT "Laboratory"."ID" AS k, ("Laboratory"."T-BIL" - "Laboratory"."IGM") AS m1 FROM "Laboratory" WHERE ("Laboratory"."T-BIL" - "Laboratory"."IGM") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT AVG(("Laboratory"."RBC" - "Laboratory"."IGM")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2, (CAST(AVG(("Laboratory"."RBC" - "Laboratory"."IGM")) AS REAL) / COUNT(*)) AS m3 FROM "Laboratory"
